title: Patch: the dungeon run's map layer is fuzzed with refusal and invariant checks
thread:
**Issue #4247 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4247: Patch: the dungeon run's map layer is fuzzed with refusal and invariant checks
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Today the dungeon run is checked with fixed scripts and one guided playthrough that always picks sensible map choices. This adds an automatic random test that also picks silly and illegal choices on the map: stepping where no path leads, buying what the run cannot afford, keeping too many cards from a pack, or removing the last card. Illegal choices must be refused without changing anything, and every accepted step must leave a sensible run: health within its max, coins and tickets never below zero, the deck never over its cap, no relic held twice, and the saved file still replays to the same run. Players notice fewer stuck or corrupted runs, and the maintainer notices map bugs before they ship.

## Why

The engine has a systematic safety net and the run does not. `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs` holds eighteen checks (I1–I18) over every fuzzed game, and `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` also probes each game with wrong-seat, reused-nonce, malformed-answer and impossible-choice actions, each owed a refusal with no events. The run layer has no equivalent monitor. `crates/run/src/lib.rs` promises `run_reduce` leaves the state unchanged on refusal, but `crates/run/src/tests.rs` checks state equality after a refusal only in spots (for example the max-HP event test), while the shop and setup tests assert the refusal message without asserting the state is untouched. `crates/tools/src/run_sim.rs` (`candidates`/`choose`) only ever tries plausible choices in a fixed preference order and calls a dead end a fault, so it never sends the illegal map actions a misclick or a future screen could send. The map, pack, shop, campfire, event and shrine rules it would be checking live in SPEC §15.5, §15.7 and §15.8, with caps in `crates/run/src/config.rs` (`RUN_DECK_MAX` is the engine library cap, `RUN_KEEP_MAX` is 5, `RUN_MAX_HP` is hero health 30, plus coin/ticket balances, distinct curses per R4067000, and one copy of each relic per §15.4).

## Proposal

Add a small run-layer checker plus a random-policy map test that stubs fight results instead of playing AI games, so the work stays in the run and its harness:

- Add a run invariant helper in `crates/run` (unit-tested): deck length within `RUN_DECK_MAX`, health within 0 and the computed max except on a dead run, coins and tickets never negative, no duplicate artifact ids, deck ids distinct, curses distinct, score terms never negative, and `run_fold` of the file replays to the live state.
- Add a map-only fuzz test (fast seeds per pull request, wider seeds daily): from random seeds, walk whole runs with a random policy over `run_next_cols` and the phase's legal actions, and at each step also fire one random illegal action (wrong column, over-keep, overspend, bad index, extracting the last card). Assert every refusal returns `Err` with the state clone-equal to before, and every acceptance keeps the invariants and folds.
- Keep fight outcomes synthetic (`FightOver` reports written directly) so the test needs no AI search and stays deterministic from the run seed and cursor.
- No rules change and no new ruling: this holds the existing §15 contract.

Rejected alternative: extending the engine I-monitor to cover runs, or replaying full AI fights per map step as `run-sim` does. Both were rejected as slower and wider than needed: the first mixes two layers with different states, the second pulls the AI and its budgets into what should be a cheap map test.

## Where it lands

- `crates/run/src/` (new small invariants module plus `run_reduce`/`run_fold` call sites as the oracle, no behaviour change) and `crates/run/src/tests.rs` (or a new `map_fuzz_tests.rs`) for the random-policy test.
- `crates/tools/src/run_sim.rs` only as a reader: reuse its seed/policy shape if handy, but the new test lives with the run so it runs without the tools binary.
- SPEC §15.5 (map and paths), §15.7 (packs, shops, extraction), §15.8 (campfire, events, chests, shrines), §15.4 (one copy of each relic), §15.10 (score terms). No spec wording change expected.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A new test plays random map-only runs (stubbed fight results) over fixed seeds and passes.
- [ ] The same test fails if any of these is broken on purpose: deck over `RUN_DECK_MAX` accepted, coins or tickets going negative accepted, a duplicate artifact accepted, a refused illegal action mutating the state (checked by clone equality), or a log that does not `run_fold` back to the live end.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-run` passes, including the new test, within the crate's usual few seconds.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-run --all-targets -- -D warnings` pass with no new allows.
- [ ] No changes under `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/` or `bot/`, and no card, engine-rule or spec behaviour change.

## Size and risks

Size: medium (one small checker plus one test file, roughly a handful of files, no migration, no client or server work). Difficulty should stay medium: it touches run rules test-only, not engine combat or card scripts. Main risk is time and flakes: random map walks could be slow or seed-sensitive, mitigated by tiny fixed seed counts per pull request with the wider sweep behind `#[ignore = \"daily: ...\"]`, fixed seeds replayed by number, and no wall-clock or AI search in the loop (fights stubbed, draws from the run seed and cursor only).

| `crates/run/src/invariants.rs` | new | `pub(crate) fn check_run_invariants(&RunState, &RunContent) -> Result<(), String>` plus `#[cfg(test)]` unit tests for the two clauses `walk_tests` lacks |
| `crates/run/src/lib.rs` | change | Two module lines: `mod invariants;` and `#[cfg(test)] mod map_fuzz_tests;` |

| `crates/run/src/walk_tests.rs` | change | Delete private `check_state`, call the shared checker; make `free_action` and `random_action` `pub(crate)` for reuse |
| `crates/run/src/map_fuzz_tests.rs` | new | `illegal_action` generator, one-run driver, one fast test plus one `#[ignore = "daily: …"]` wide test |
| `crates/run/README.md` | change | One line in the Tests paragraph naming the new file |

Do not touch: `crates/engine`, `crates/cards`, `crates/ai`, `crates/tools` (read-only reference), `apps/web`, `e2e`, anything under `spec/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`. No new ruling: every refusal string asserted already exists (§15.5, R3583000, R3584001).

## Steps

1. In `crates/run/src/config.rs`, after `WALK_TURNS_MAX`, add in the same `#[cfg(test)]` style: `pub const MAP_FUZZ_SEEDS: usize = 10;` (seeds per content for the pull-request test) and `pub const MAP_FUZZ_DAILY_SEEDS: usize = 300;` (seeds per content for the ignored wide sweep), each with a one-line doc comment naming its test.
2. Create `crates/run/src/invariants.rs`. Move `walk_tests.rs`'s `check_state` body there verbatim as `pub(crate) fn check_run_invariants(state: &RunState, content: &RunContent) -> Result<(), String>`, keeping its messages (`"hp … while dead"`, `"coins …"`, `"twice"`, `"level"`, `"deck"`), then add two clauses: curses distinct (`"curse {id} twice"`) and each `run_score_terms` field non-negative (`"score term {name} {value}"`). Treat `Won` as alive (`1 <= hp <= run_max_hp`); `Dead` requires `hp == 0`. Needs only `super::*` plus `crate::config::{RUN_ARTIFACT_LEVEL_MAX, RUN_DECK_MAX}`.
3. In `crates/run/src/lib.rs`, add `mod invariants;` beside `mod fight;` and `#[cfg(test)] mod map_fuzz_tests;` beside the other test modules.
4. In `crates/run/src/walk_tests.rs`, delete `fn check_state` and import `crate::invariants::check_run_invariants`; replace its three call sites (`check_state(&state, &content)`) one for one. Change `fn free_action` and `fn random_action` to `pub(crate) fn`. Update the nine `walk_*_fails` tests to call `check_run_invariants`; they now cover the shared helper, so add no duplicates for old clauses.
5. In `crates/run/src/invariants.rs`, add `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` with two tests: `invariants_a_curse_twice_fails` (clone `started`-style state with one curse pushed twice, following `walk_an_artifact_twice_fails`' pattern but building setup/curses from `run_placeholder_content()`) and `invariants_a_negative_score_term_fails` (state with `stats.damage_dealt = -1`). Each asserts the error string names its field.
6. Create `crates/run/src/map_fuzz_tests.rs`. Reuse `crate::walk_tests::{free_action, random_action}` and `crate::invariants::check_run_invariants`; own setup helper with seed `run_seed(&format!("mapfuzz-4247-{tag}-{n}"))`, starter `content.starter_access[..RUN_STARTER_SIZE]`, artifacts `vec!["temp-greedy"]` on placeholder and none on catalog (copy `walk_setup`'s tag split), random curse subset via the walk `Rng` (never touching the run's `rng_cursor`, per rule 4).
7. In the same file, write `fn illegal_action(state: &RunState, content: &RunContent, rng: &mut Rng) -> RunAction`: `Map` → `Go { col }` with `col` = first index of the row's width absent from `run_next_cols` (falls back to `width`, out of range); `Fight` → `Leave` (wrong-phase, always refused); `Reward { Some }` → `OpenPack { index: 0 }`; `Reward { None }` → `TakeArtifact { take: true }`; `Pack` → `Keep { cards: vec![outsider] }` where outsider is a pool id absent from `cards` (always fails membership or length); `ExtractCard` → `Extract { index: Some(deck.len()) }`, or `Some(0)` when `deck.len() == 1` (last-card refusal); `ExtractArtifact` → `Extract { index: Some(artifacts.len()) }`; `Shop` → rotate by `rng.int(3)`: `Buy { index: stock.len() }`, `RemoveCard { index: deck.len() }`, `LevelArtifact { index: artifacts.len() }`; `Campfire` → `RemoveCards { indices: vec![0] }` (wrong count); `Event` → `Choose { index: options.len() }` via the content's event def; `Shrine` → `Bless { index: Some(offers.len()) }`. `Won`/`Dead` are unreachable.
8. In the same file, write the driver `fn drive(content, tag, n)`: loop until `Won`/`Dead` (cap iterations at `WALK_MAX_STEPS`, panic naming phase past it). Each iteration: clone `before = state.clone()`, call `run_reduce(&state, content, &illegal_action(…))`; on `Err` assert `state == before` (input untouched) and count the refusal; on `Ok` run `check_run_invariants` on the result. Then pick the legal action exactly as `walk` does (`free_action`, plus up to `WALK_TRIES` `random_action` retries when `rng.int(PERCENT) >= WALK_WAY_ON_PERCENT`, else `free`), apply it, run `check_run_invariants`, push to `log`, and assert `run_fold(&RunFile { setup, unlocks, log }, content) == Ok(state)` every accepted step. At the end assert the refusal count is above zero and return.
9. Add the tests: `map_fuzz_random_policy_with_illegal_probes_stays_in_bounds_and_replays` loops `("placeholder", run_placeholder_content())` and `("catalog", fight_tests::catalog_content())` over `0..MAP_FUZZ_SEEDS` calling `drive`; `#[ignore = "daily: three hundred seeds per content; the fast test holds the bounds per pull request"] map_fuzz_daily_wide_sweep` does the same over `0..MAP_FUZZ_DAILY_SEEDS`.
10. In `crates/run/README.md`, extend the Tests paragraph's `walk_tests` sentence with one clause naming `src/map_fuzz_tests.rs` (random-policy map walks with illegal-action refusal and per-step replay checks).
11. Verify the five acceptance mutants one at a time, reverting each before the next: comment out the `deck_room` cap in `keep_count`; make `spend_coins` skip its check; remove the `!held` filter in `random_artifact`; make `run_reduce` return `Ok` on `apply`'s `Err`; make `run_fold` skip the last log action. The new fast test must go red in each case (invariants, refusal, or fold assertion respectively).

## Tests

- `crates/run/src/invariants.rs`: `invariants_a_curse_twice_fails`, `invariants_a_negative_score_term_fails`.
- `crates/run/src/map_fuzz_tests.rs`: `map_fuzz_random_policy_with_illegal_probes_stays_in_bounds_and_replays`, plus ignored `map_fuzz_daily_wide_sweep`.
- Existing `walk_*` tests in `crates/run/src/walk_tests.rs` now exercise the shared checker; they must pass unchanged in behavior.
- Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-run map_fuzz`, `cargo test -p jackioh-run invariants`, `cargo test -p jackioh-run` (whole crate, features as usual), `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-run --all-targets -- -D warnings`. (`cargo jackioh spec check` needs no run: no ruling added or cited.)

## Done when

- [ ] Fast fuzz test and the two invariant unit tests pass; whole `cargo test -p jackioh-run` passes in the usual few seconds; daily sweep compiles and runs under `-- --ignored`.
- [ ] Each of the five spot-mutations in step 11 turns the new test red, then is reverted.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` and the crate clippy gate pass with no new allows.
- [ ] No rule, card, or spec behavior changed; nothing outside `crates/run` touched.

## Risks

- Flakes or slowness: seeds are fixed strings replayed by number; the walk `Rng` is separate from the run's `rng_cursor`, so draws stay deterministic; fights are synthetic `FightOver` values (clamped HP, bounded counters copied from `walk_tests`' ranges), no AI search or wall clock. Per-step `run_fold` is O(log) rebuilds on logs of a few hundred actions; the PR count stays at 10 seeds per content.
- `Won`-phase HP: the final-boss win refills to the new max before extraction, so `1 <= hp <= max` holds; if a content ever extracts HP away, the invariant (not the rules) gets fixed.
- Catalog drift: the catalog-content leg uses `fight_tests::catalog_content()` exactly as `walk_tests` does, so card patches affect both equally.

## Open questions

None.
```
